The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 88c226e29ee72119), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 31. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: Let V be a normal projective canonical complex variety of dimension n ≥ 2, with KV ∼Q 0 and canonical index r. Let π : Y → V be its canonical cyclic cover. Suppose that L is an ample rational Cartier divisor and C1 > 0 is rational, with 1 ≤ Ln ≤ 2, γ(L; V ) ≤ C1. Choose a positive rational number b0 such that 3(2b0)n < 1 4 , b0(C1 + 1) < 3 4 . (7.1) For every integer t ≥ 2, set Zt = Y t /µr,diag, θt : Zt −→ V t , Pt = θ∗ t L⊞t . Then Pt is ample and ε(Pt) ≤ (n + 1)t2 b0 . (7.2)
